SUBJECT: VENDOR INSPECTION OF DOOSAN ENERBILITY’S QUALITY ASSURANCE
PROGRAM AND TITLE 10 OF THE CODE OF FEDERAL REGULATIONS
PART 21 PROGRAM IMPLEMENTATION
Dear Mr. Kim:
This letter documents the U.S. Nuclear Regulatory Commission (NRC) staff’s plan to perform an
inspection of Doosan Enerbility’s Appendix B, “Quality Assurance Program Criteria for Nuclear
Power Plants and Reprocessing Plants,” to Title 10 of the Code of Federal Regulations (10
CFR) Part 50, “Domestic Licensing of Production and Utilization Facilities,” quality program and
10 CFR Part 21, “Reporting of Defects and Noncompliance,” programs as they pertain to
activities conducted at your facility related to the supply of safety-related components to U.S
nuclear power plants. As discussed in a telephone call on Tuesday, April 2, 2024, the NRC
inspection team plans to arrive at your facility on Monday, May 20, 2024, and will conduct an
inspection through Friday, May 24, 2024. After the inspection, a report will be issued and
transmitted to you via letter. The lead inspector for this effort is Mr. Yamir Diaz-Castillo; you may
contact him at (301) 415-2228 or via electronic mail at Yamir.Diaz-Castillo@nrc.gov.
The following docket number has been assigned to your facility: 99901373. Please reference
this number on any correspondence sent to the NRC.
Sincerely,
Ayegbusi, Odunayo signing on behalf
of Kavanagh, Kerri
on 04/05/24
Kerri Kavanagh, Chief
Quality Assurance and Vendor Inspection Branch
Division of Reactor Oversight
Office of Nuclear Reactor Regulation
Docket No.: 99901373
